This is the complete, final backend implementation checklist for the Holy Grail Refinery — a 35-agent AI-powered distributed software engineering system. It incorporates the original 158 implementation tasks from v1.0, enriched and extended with 113 additional tasks identified during a structured gap analysis against 12 industry standards. All tasks are unified into a single authoritative checklist organized across 12 sections. Every task must be completed and verified before the system advances to enterprise customer readiness review.

API1–API10: broken auth, injection, SSRF, security misconfiguration
Elite: deploy on-demand, MTTR <1h, change failure rate <5%

Instead, it activates a precisely orchestrated 7-phase pipeline — the Smelt-Cycle — that routes the work through 35 specialized agents, each contributing a defined slice of comprehension, verification, and construction.

This document follows that exact journey from the moment the user presses Enter to the moment a deployable binary lands back in front of them. Every agent is identified, their role in that specific moment is described, and the data they produce or consume is called out.

Protocol Sigma (Knowledge) — IS Agent → All Pods. Documentation broadcasts and context injection.
Protocol Omega (User) — PM Agent ↔ Human. The only protocol that touches the user directly.
Protocol Rho (Traffic) — API Broker → All. Rate limiting, key routing, flow control across every protocol.
